CustomField.description: Adds a Delete action that removes a row on Repeater and Table sections. Button text comes from Delete Action Button Label, and on Tables the confirmation window uses the Table Delete Action Modal Title, Subtitle and Body. Not offered once the section is down to its Min rows.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Turn on to let users delete rows from this repeater or table. Set the button label with Delete Action Button Label; deletion is blocked below the Min row count.
CustomField.label: Enable Delete Action
